content.short: Oriole Insights is a one-of-a-kind price prediction platform implemented in a simple gaming format.
content.description: Oriole Insights aims to build a digital community in which reputation stands as the core of a person’s identity. Within this platform, every prediction mirrors the predictor’s experience, track record, and learning from past successes and missteps. By clearly rewarding accuracy and by establishing transparent reputation scores, Oriole Insights creates an ecosystem that recognizes and rewards the most capable forecasters for their insight and judgment.
